description: ONEOK, Inc. is incorporated under the laws of the state of Oklahoma with its common stock listed on the NYSE under the trading symbol OKE, and it delivers energy products and services vital to an advancing world as a leading midstream service provider of gathering, processing, fractionation, transportation, storage and marine export services, and as one of the largest integrated energy infrastructure companies in North America it delivers energy that makes a difference in the lives of people in the U.S. and around the world, transporting through its approximately 60,000-mile pipeline network the natural gas, NGLs, refined products and crude oil that help meet domestic and international energy demand, contribute to energy security and provide safe, reliable and responsible energy solutions needed today and into the future.
